remarks: Experience the Freshness of a New Home! Completed in 2024, this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers a pristine interior and exterior, along with brand-new mechanical systems for ultimate peace of mind. Located at the end of a cul-de-sac in the Cove area, this home is just minutes from Cove Island Park & Beach, Chelsea Piers, restaurants, I-95, and the Darien border. In addition to 4 bedrooms, this home has a very large laundry room plus office! But it doesn't end there! There's a walk-up attic on the 3rd level, perfect for a playroom, media room, or family room - the possibilities are endless. Step outside to a private, fully fenced yard with a patio, perfect for outdoor entertaining or relaxation. Parking is never an issue with a garage, private driveway, and additional space on the cul-de-sac. This stunning 2024 renovation is ready for immediate move-in. Don't miss the chance to make it yours-schedule a viewing today!
